requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Host could not be resolved from the research environment; no TLS/session or viewer inspection was possible.
Confirmed municipal bureau and a non-public registration information platform context; no safe anonymous geometry response.
Ziyang land-transaction notice includes a parcel code for a specific offered tract, but it is not a citywide cadastral geometry service and was not used as a sample.

blocker: No public anonymous Ziyang parcel geometry response with a verified native parcel identity was obtained. The municipal domain was DNS-unreachable; first-party documents describe custodianship and registration workflows only.
remainingUncertainty: A zero hit was not tested and does not imply citywide absence. Coverage, service endpoints, schema, CRS and parcel identity remain unverified.
nextStep: Retry the official Ziyang municipal natural-resources site when DNS/service access is available, follow its public JavaScript/configuration if a viewer exists, and request only a small bounded geometry-plus-ID response around the unchanged WUP locator.
